sloka: सलक्ष्मणं राघवमाजिमर्दनं दिशागजं मत्तमिव व्यवस्थितम् ।सहेत को वानरमुख्य संयुगे युगान्तसूर्यप्रतिमं शरार्चिषम् ।। ५.३७.६५।।।।
transliteration: salakṣmaṇaṁ rāghavamājimardanaṁ diśāgajaṁ mattamiva vyavasthitam ।saheta ko vānaramukhya saṁyuge yugāntasūryapratimaṁ śarārciṣam ।। 5.37.65।।।।

translations.english: "After seeing Rama who is equal to lord Indra in valour. He is like blazing fire whipped by wind, wielding a wonderful bow, who can withstand the power of strong Rama accompanied by Lakshmana in war?
